title: Nav cleanup and Lucide menu icons
summary: Primary Admin navigation only appears when you can open an Admin section, and missing menu icons now render correctly across Admin, Recruitment, and service hubs.
changes: Show the Admin primary menu only when at least one Admin page is allowed, and open the first permitted section.
Register Lucide icons used by Recruitment, hub Create actions, and page submenus so labels no longer appear without icons.
Add icons to Admin and Recruitment page submenus and to hub “What you can do” tool links.
affected_areas: Recruitment public and staff page submenus
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39.x line: navigation visibility and icon rendering polish with no new product capability.
validation: Live QA role switcher checks for Public, Staff, Admin, and Super Admin menus and icons
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data migrations are included.
